nClaude.text: Claude task. Same page and same Properties box as a designer task; agent, model and effort are live here. Only the description differs: Goal, Decided, Files, Design, Leave alone and Check, each on its own lines, the check as a code block.

nEpic.text: Epic. Written: an 'In short' block and 'Why it exists' line under the title; Status holds one word; each finding opens with a short bold line and its Decided or Proposed tag. Rendered: facts row, progress, findings folded, tasks as a table.

nHuman.text: Designer task. Same page and same Properties box as a Claude task: every value can be changed there, and Claude changes the same fields with doit set. Only the description differs: the story on three lines (As, I want, so that), then What to do as numbered steps, then Today and Source.

nProject.text: Project. Written: one 'In short' line at the top of the project's README or design doc. Rendered: the board builds the rest (active epic, your tasks, epic list) from data it already has.

rowTitle.text: The Detail column: project, epic, task
